milestones.label: Federal minimum age for most nonagricultural work
milestones.population: young people working in nonagricultural jobs covered by the federal Fair Labor Standards Act
whatChanges: Federal law sets this as the minimum age for employment in most nonagricultural jobs.
Federal law still limits how many hours minors may work, until they reach the later age at which those caps lift.

milestones.label: Federal hour limits lift for nonhazardous work
milestones.population: young people working in nonagricultural jobs covered by the federal Fair Labor Standards Act
whatChanges: Federal caps on hours stop applying, and any nonhazardous job may be worked for unlimited hours.
Occupations the Secretary of Labor has declared hazardous stay closed under federal law until a later age.

milestones.label: Federal minimum age for hazardous nonagricultural work
milestones.population: people working in nonagricultural occupations the Secretary of Labor has declared hazardous
whatChanges: The federal hazardous occupations orders stop applying, opening work such as roofing, excavation, mining, logging, demolition, and operating power-driven machines.
The federal youth employment provisions no longer apply at all, so no federal age bar remains on any job.
Below this age, limited apprentice and student-learner exemptions let some of these occupations be performed under supervision.

milestones.label: Reaching the age of majority

variesByState.note: Most states set majority at the age used federally for adulthood, while a small number of states set it higher.

milestones.population: people under the majority statute of the state where they live
whatChanges: Adult legal status attaches: signing binding contracts and leases, holding and conveying property, and carrying the responsibilities state law assigns to adults.
Some state statutes also end minority early for a person who marries before reaching the stated age.
Because the age is set state by state, the same birthday can carry different legal weight after a move.

milestones.label: Minimum age to marry under state law
milestones.researchNote: Needs one compilation covering all fifty states, not individual state statutes, since two statutes cannot establish national endpoints. Query: a National Conference of State Legislatures or Congressional Research Service table of state statutory minimum marriage ages, which must state the highest state floor and say how states without a statutory minimum are handled.
milestones.windowInWords: around the age at which state law treats a person as an adult, with some states allowing marriage earlier under conditions their statutes set
